It always prevents the illness it detects.

replacing diagnosis with public campaigns.
providing prompt and accurate follow-up.

precisely predictable.
entirely tax-free.
insecure and liable to change.

sentences.en: Charcoal found beneath an ancient wall was dated to a period two centuries earlier than the settlement described in written records.

definitive.
irrelevant.

sentences.en: Planting a single crop over a large area may increase efficiency in the short term, but it can reduce habitats for wild pollinators.

options.text: Every farm reported an immediate jump in crop production.

options.diagnosis: 正确：准确保留 some 和时间延迟
options.text: Insect diversity increased on some farms without immediate yield gains.
Pollinating species vanished from all surveyed farms.
Monoculture ceased to be used anywhere in the region.

options.text: Economic efficiency can never be measured.

options.diagnosis: 与 pollinator habitat 的论证相反

options.diagnosis: 正确：精确对应最终总结
options.text: Long-term ecological health and yearly production are different measures.

questions.stem: What distinction does the passage emphasize?
questions.whyCorrect: s3 提醒把生态韧性与年度产量分开评估。

Additional lanes always make roads physically narrower.
Commuters are required to stop using public transport.

utterly dismissive of transport planning.

options.text: cautious about its long-term effectiveness.

options.diagnosis: 否认 s1 的 initially shorten

questions.stem: The author’s view of road expansion is best described as

Reliable broadband.
Regular mentoring for some learners.

options.text: treating enrolment counts as proof of meaningful learning access.
checking whether students have suitable devices.

options.diagnosis: 有助于满足 s2 的条件
options.text: improving broadband connectivity in remote areas.

sentences.en: Peer review can catch problems in a paper, but acceptance by a journal does not guarantee that its findings are correct.

options.text: Publishing a study is equivalent to proving its findings.

options.diagnosis: failed replicate 不等于证明造假
options.text: A failed replication proves that every earlier study was fabricated.

options.diagnosis: 正确：综合三句且不夸大
options.text: Research credibility requires evidence beyond publication and procedural safeguards.
Pre-registration makes independent studies unnecessary.

questions.stem: What is the central claim of the passage?
questions.whyCorrect: 三句依次限制发表、复现和预注册的保证程度，核心是证据必须继续积累。

options.diagnosis: 正确：保留 may 与不能保证事实
options.text: It can curb a reporting bias without proving the result true.

It automatically increases the sample size.

options.diagnosis: pre-表示事先且 s3 是预注册方法
options.text: It is performed only after all results have been published.

solveSteps: 找出 peer review 所能做的事

options.diagnosis: 正确：准确表达缺记录的逻辑边界

options.text: unreserved acceptance.
complete rejection.
indifference to all sources.

options.diagnosis: 正确：同时保留益处与限制
options.text: qualified appreciation.
